repo_meta_data.description: Pronounced "HTTP" - because sometimes the best fucking code comes with wordplay. A Go library that does everything you need and nothing you don't. Spin up a production-ready server with middleware, WebSocket hubs, file uploads, static serving, request proxying with caching, and OpenAPI validation.
